biography:
Kimi Wilson, a name whispered with anticipation in the New Zealand racing scene, hails from a small coastal town known more for its surfing than its speedways. Born into a family of sheep farmers, Kimi's passion for racing ignited after stumbling upon a dusty, forgotten go-kart in their barn at age 10. What started as reckless fun in the paddocks quickly transformed into a burning ambition. Kimi began tearing up local karting circuits, drawing attention with a flamboyant style and raw talent. 

At 15, Kimi made the audacious leap to Formula Ford, self-funding the endeavor by working odd jobs and securing small sponsorships. Early results were mixed, flashes of brilliance interspersed with rookie errors. A defining moment came at the Manfeild Circuit Chris Amon, where, despite starting last after a mechanical failure, Kimi fought through the field, executing a daring last-corner overtake to snatch victory. 

That race cemented Kimi’s reputation as a rising star, attracting the attention of independent teams willing to bet on raw talent. Now at 17, Kimi is competing in the Toyota Racing Series, navigating the challenges of a higher level of competition. While still honing consistency, Kimi's undeniable speed and audacious maneuvers make them one of the most exciting prospects to watch.
drivingStyle: Kimi's driving style is best described as 'controlled chaos'. Known for late-braking maneuvers and aggressive corner entries, Kimi isn't afraid to push the car to its absolute limit. While this occasionally leads to spectacular overtakes, it also results in costly errors. Kimi's tire management is still a work in progress, often sacrificing early-race pace for a final-lap surge. Under pressure, Kimi tends to thrive, relishing the challenge of head-to-head battles.

rivalries.reason: Rossi, a seasoned veteran, publicly criticized Kimi's aggressive driving style, leading to a heated exchange of words after a controversial collision at Teretonga Park.
Dubois and Wilson have a fierce on-track rivalry stemming from a championship karting battle where Dubois narrowly defeated Wilson.
Tanaka, a calculated and precise driver, represents the antithesis of Kimi's flamboyant style, resulting in a clash of personalities and racing philosophies.

quirks: Always wears a lucky silver fern pendant given by their grandmother before every race.
Listens to loud punk rock music to get pumped up before getting in the car.
Has a pre-race ritual of drawing a small smiley face on the steering wheel with a dry-erase marker.
famousQuote: "You can't win races by being polite. Sometimes, you gotta send it!"
careerHighlight: Winning the Formula Ford race at Manfeild Circuit Chris Amon after starting last due to a mechanical failure, showcasing incredible overtaking skills and determination.
careerLowPoint: Spinning out of the lead in a Toyota Racing Series race at Hampton Downs Motorsport Park due to overzealous driving, costing the team a potential victory.
